title: The Saffron Weighs Light
brief: Stand 7 locked from inside, saffron gone, owner insists on ghosts. 4 suspects. One lies.

places.name: Stand 7
places.description: Spice stand, shutter half-down, saffron smell + bleach.

places.name: Back storage
places.description: Cramped, padlocked from inside earlier. Thread on latch.

places.name: Cafe next door
places.description: Mira was seen here 18:20, claims home.

clues.title: Rigged scale
clues.text: Scale shows 110g for 100g weight. Someone skimmed for months.

clues.title: Bleach wipe
clues.text: Counter wiped with bleach, saffron dust in grout remains.

clues.title: Inside bolt
clues.text: Door bolted from inside. Window latch fresh scratches.

clues.title: Thread trick
clues.text: Black thread on latch + bolt - classic inside-job thread pull.

clues.title: 18:22 receipt
clues.text: Cafe receipt: Mira, Melange, 18:22. Not home.

clues.title: Linen fibres
clues.text: Blue linen fibres on window sill match Jose's bag.

clues.title: Double ledger
clues.text: Owner kept two ledgers, skimmed too. Motive to fake theft?

clues.title: Grey Captain tale
clues.text: Local ghost story owner uses to scare staff.

suspects.name: Mira H.
suspects.truth: Saw Jose leave at 18:20 with linen bag. Hid because she pocketed cash earlier.
suspects.leak_condition: Present clue_scale or clue_receipt, or ask 3x about 18:00-19:00, then admit cafe + seeing Jose

suspects.name: Jose P.
suspects.truth: Took saffron through window, faked inside bolt with thread. Linen bag.
suspects.leak_condition: Present clue_key or clue_thread or clue_linen, then slips to 'okay I was there but didn't take'

statements.text: I left at 17:00, never went back.
Bolted from inside - must be the ghost, no?

suspects.name: Frau E.
suspects.truth: Skimmed with rigged scale for months. Called ghost to avoid audit. Did not steal saffron tonight.
suspects.leak_condition: Present clue_ledger or clue_scale, then admits skimming but denies tonight

statements.text: My books are clean for 20 years.
The Grey Captain took it, same as Salem.

suspects.name: Ahmed K.
suspects.truth: Served Mira 18:22, saw Jose with linen bag 18:25 toward U4. Neutral witness.
suspects.leak_condition: Always truthful, but vague unless asked for times

statements.text: Mira was here around half six, yes.
Saw Jose with a bag heading to Kettenbrueckengasse.

solution.method: hid in lager, slipped out window, pulled bolt with thread, linen bag
solution.motive: debt + knew owner skimmed so theft would be blamed on audit/ghost

validator_prompt: You are a detective. You only know places + found clues + transcript. Can you deduce who/how/why? Return JSON {solvable:bool, chain:[], missing:''}. If unsolvable with required_contradictions, reject case.
